Initial placement-stream pointer consumed by resident $7514/$4D0F before the private initialization callback.
Background and border color bytes. Loader uses pristine backup $3804/$3805 when publishing VIC colors.

Initial player X low, X high and Y in hardware sprite coordinates, read by spawn $56E0. This is the start of each life, not multicolor drawing coordinates.

Resident perimeter-bullet slot limit 0; $6800 considers sprite slots1 through limit-minus-one. Private level actors can use other slots.
Ordinary collection adds this little-endian binary value (100) to the24-bit total score. Private callbacks may add an extra award first.
Initial little-endian bonus 0. The resident countdown subtracts100 per256 enabled IRQ services; completion adds the remaining amount to total and bonus records.
Private initialization routine called after initial scenery drawing. Common no-op target is the RTS at $301F.
Main-thread entry selected by JMP($301B) at $759C; typically the spawn/collection/exit loop at $3050.

Eight ladder/up-rope X columns followed by six down-rope X columns, copied to $40B0-$40BD. Coordinates use160-wide multicolor space; $FF marks unavailable columns.

Ordinary successful-level destination $5B00. The private loop calls cleanup before jumping through this word.
Exhausted-lives destination $5FFD, the resident jump to game-over presentation $6A80. This is separate from successful completion.
Two filename suffix characters '27'. Resident loader copies them into $40D3/$40D4; private cleanup can replace them before the next disk request.
Single $FF drawing-stream terminator, used as the no-change post-bomb action.
Zero byte after the empty drawing terminator and before collection-key coordinate offsets.
X/Y offsets applied by resident $55BF when reducing player position to the bomb lookup key. They adjust the coarse cell test, not the visible bomb positions.
Optional hook called before the matched bomb-record callback. A zero high byte suppresses the call; otherwise the resident patches JSR $5643 from this word.
Twenty loaded zero bytes align the private main loop to $3050. Header fields end at $303B; no private structure is assigned to this gap.

Spawn a life through $436A, poll status/input through $436D, and test bombs remaining at $3013. Zero bombs calls cleanup and jumps through completion vector $3030. Death mode 2 waits to become 0; reserves $40E4=$FF calls cleanup and jumps through exhaustion vector $3032, otherwise respawn. Cleanup vector $301D is invoked through a patched JSR.

Ignore player collisions containing bit 1, the player-shot sprite. Otherwise any nonzero player collision starts death while mode is 0. A simultaneous player-shot/enemy contact also takes the bit-1 exemption.

Drawing data $30A8-$30FC read by Initial scenery $30A8. Stream commands are FE shape pointer, FD repeat delta, FC stream jump, x/y/count placement and FF end. Referenced shapes hold width/x-offset/y-offset/pixel rows endingFF; source pixel codes are0 background,1 bomb,2 support,3 climbable. Parsed by the same behavioral renderer checked against original $4D0F.

1 seven-byte records [coarse key,x,y,callback low/high,post-draw low/high]. Terminator: $FF. Coordinates are160-wide bitmap positions. The resident scanner matches the key, calls both hooks, adds $3015 points, erases the bomb, follows the draw pointer and decrements $3013. This list is not bounded by the target counter.

Signed Y deltas $FE,0,2,0 for up/right/down/left.

Initialize sprites 5-7 from biased position bases $316D/$316F, using frame $20, colour 12, enabled. Slot 5 X reads the ending RTS opcode $60 at $3172 as data. Slots 6/7 use explicit X=8 and Y=152/216; the moving-enemy updater processes only those two slots.
Four explicit bytes: X=8,8 followed by Y=152,216 for enemies 6/7. Slot 5 initialization also reads neighbouring code/data bytes, producing a static auxiliary sprite.

Three-byte enemy route records. Commands 0-3 select cardinal velocity and duration; the third byte is unused. $FF jumps to the following little-endian address. Commands $10-$13 jump only when matching player quadrant $3366, otherwise skip. Initial pointers are $3267/$3270, and a hit restarts at $3267. All jump targets stay within this script block.

For enemies 6/7, decrement route countdown and apply signed X/Y velocity plus frame animation. At zero fetch commands through pointers $313D/$3145: $FF always jumps, $10-$13 jump on matching quadrant $3366, and 0-3 install direction/duration. A newly selected movement applies immediately.

Compute player X/2 into $3367. Select route condition $10-$13 by comparing player position with one of four X/Y threshold pairs at $3369/$336D, indexed by kill counter $3368&3. Tail-call $33C9 to advance shots. The native first kill advances the selector from0 to1: X/2,Y thresholds52,78 become92,100. At the captured player position288,56, both pairs select$11. A change in the selected enemy route is not established by that contact alone.
Current route condition $10-$13, cached player X/2, and enemy kill counter. Each 100-point kill advances the counter, changing the threshold pair used to steer enemies.
Four X/2 thresholds 52,92,132,92 followed by four Y thresholds 78,100,122,100. Kill counter &3 selects a pair. Crossing X sets the condition low bit; crossing Y adds 2.
Eight-byte sprite-indexed shot workspace holding state: 0 inactive, 1 newly fired, 2 moving. Active shot slots are 1 for the player and 2/3 for enemies.
Eight-byte sprite-indexed shot workspace holding signed X velocity low byte. Active shot slots are 1 for the player and 2/3 for enemies.
Eight-byte sprite-indexed shot workspace holding signed X velocity high byte. Active shot slots are 1 for the player and 2/3 for enemies.
Eight-byte sprite-indexed shot workspace holding signed Y velocity. Active shot slots are 1 for the player and 2/3 for enemies.
Eight-byte sprite-indexed shot workspace holding direction index from the joystick nibble or enemy alignment. Active shot slots are 1 for the player and 2/3 for enemies.
Sixteen-entry joystick-direction velocity table, X low component. Cardinal directions use X=+/-6 or Y=+/-3; diagonal directions combine those deltas. Unselected combinations contain zero.
Sixteen-entry joystick-direction velocity table, X high component. Cardinal directions use X=+/-6 or Y=+/-3; diagonal directions combine those deltas. Unselected combinations contain zero.
Sixteen-entry joystick-direction velocity table, Y component. Cardinal directions use X=+/-6 or Y=+/-3; diagonal directions combine those deltas. Unselected combinations contain zero.

For shot sprites 1-3, state 1 loads directional velocity and plays noise $34FE; state 2 applies 16-bit X and 8-bit Y motion. Outside X/2=6..171 or Y=6..219, clear the state, enable byte and Y. Preserve the current slot at $34FD while scheduling sound.

Launch one player shot when direction/fire and free slot permit; always consume fire into$4053=$10, including blocked/neutral/released cases. Seven-byte SID noise stream: envelope $19/$24, frequency $3030 for 24 sound updates, zero terminator. Queued at priority 3, release 0, control $80.
